conbody.p: Guidelines for reviewing documentation changes that ship with code.

ul.li: Does the change include runnable examples or clear steps?
Is the tone consistent with project conventions?
Are conrefs/keyrefs used for shared content instead of duplication?
Are outputs (HTML/PDF) attached to the PR or viewable via CI artifacts?

section.title: Review Roles
section.p: Assign at least one technical writer and one engineer to each PR that touches documentation and code.

section.title: How to give feedback
section.p: Leave small, actionable comments. For large content redesigns, suggest a follow-up task rather than blocking a small bugfix PR.
